skill_name: In a few sentences, explain why it is important to be a good listener.
workflow: Listening actively and thoughtfully is an essential skill in any kind of communication. A good listener is an effective communicator, who can accurately interpret what other people are trying to say. Being an active listener also strengthens relationships since it demonstrates genuine care and concern for the speaker. Additionally, being a good listener reduces the chance of miscommunication, misunderstanding, and conflict. A good listener will make sure that they understand the speaker in order
